versions.changelog:
rss-manager 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides robust RSS and Atom feed parsing with error handling for encoding, XML issues, and namespace conflicts
- Deduplicates articles using advanced similarity detection (URL, title, content fingerprinting, entity overlap)
- Scores and ranks articles based on authority, recency, corroboration, social signals, and topic relevance
- Clusters related articles by topic using vectorization and entity analysis, surfacing representative stories
- Produces structured daily digests with clear topic organization, source attribution, and trend indicators
- Ensures no duplicate items, preserves attribution, and respects feed publisher update intervals
